svg.text: Rectifier → inverter → complete HVDC link; one full cycle with highlighted conduction interval

svg.title: Commutation Overlap, state 2: T1 + T3 + T6
svg.desc: Editable SCR rectifier conduction paths. Red highlights electrically closed forward-only SCR loops. In inverter operation, current enters DC+ and leaves DC-; the external DC source provides energy to the AC grid. Overlap shows connectivity, not instantaneous current sharing.

g.text: T1 + T3 + T6 | T1 outgoing → T3 incoming
Conceptual model only: ideal sinusoidal sources, constant DC current, linear current transfer during overlap; equal-reactance voltage average. Not an EMT solution.

g.text: T2 + T3 + T6 | T6 outgoing → T2 incoming
Conceptual model only: ideal sinusoidal sources, constant DC current, linear current transfer during overlap; equal-reactance voltage average. Not an EMT solution.

svg.title: HVDC LINK · JOINT STATE 11 · INVERTER COMMUTATION OVERLAP
svg.text: HVDC LINK · JOINT STATE 11 · INVERTER COMMUTATION OVERLAP

svg.title: Full LCC HVDC circuit — Inverter commutation overlap
svg.desc: Two three-phase, two-winding converter transformers, a six-pulse rectifier, two smoothing reactors, line resistance, a six-pulse inverter, and a metallic return. The red line is the union of validated complete electrical current loops.

g.text: HVDC LINK · JOINT STATE 11 · INVERTER COMMUTATION OVERLAP
Rectifier: T2 + T3 | one upper and one lower SCR carry the DC current | Inverter: T2 + T3 + T6 | T6 outgoing → T2 incoming
Conceptual model only: ideal sinusoidal sources, constant DC current, linear current transfer during overlap; equal-reactance voltage average. Not an EMT solution.
